sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Upon meeting with the Huntik Foundation Council, Dante Vale's team were sent on a mission by Teien Casterwill to activate the Blue Star and to bring the Casterwill family members out of hiding. Following the quatrains on Eathon Lambert's Holotome, Lok Lambert managed to acquire the Ring of Quetzalcoatl from the Pyramid of the Sun in the ruins of Teotihuacan, Mexico. Upon summoning the Titan and saving his teammates from Kiel and the Blood Spirals, Lok transformed Quetzalcoatl into the Blue Star. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

With the Blue Star high in the heavens, the scattered members of the Casterwill family reunited at the Fortress of Iron Will. [Sophie on Trial]

When Lok fell into a gap between dimensions while exploring Tír na nÓg, he spoke with his father, Eathon Lambert, who hinted to Lok that the Blue Star would be necessary when confronting the Betrayer. [Back Home]

During the battle against the Betrayer and the Legendary Titan of Betrayal, Demigorgan, Lok transformed the Blue Star back into Quetzalcoatl. [Dante's Return]
